manifest.name: gdn-q4k-mlp-early8-mid24-skip0-attn-blockfit-rest-lmhead
manifest.description: The recurrent and MLP Q4_K windows of gdn-attn-q4k-mlp-early8-mid24-skip0 (#37: 0.1091, decode 96.2, prefill 10,258, 20.92 GiB), but with attention kept on NVFP4 and every NVFP4 projection re-encoded by nvfp4_blockfit, lm_head fitted once from BF16. Two changes against #37 that pull the same way: the 31 MLP layers (9-23 and 48-63) and layer 0 leave round-to-nearest bytes for blockfit (#28 cut an all-NVFP4 map from 0.1357 to 0.0992 with the same kernels), and the 64 attention projections leave the runtime Q4_K fit, the one place where Q4_K cost task answers (V5: -33 of 784) and where blockfit NVFP4 bytes are closest to BF16. Attention is 6.6% of the weights, so decode and peak memory should sit within noise of #37 and its prefill should rise a little; drift is expected near 0.092-0.097 with tasks at or above #37's 572.
